intro: July 4 (US Independence Day, Saturday) — no new fundamental data. Framework update: BTC Gate 1 CONFIRMED (July 3 UTC midnight close $62,579.40), Gate 2 TRACKING ($62,491 current, $62,331 intraday low), long-term BTC conviction upgraded from MEDIUM (watch) to MEDIUM (buy-imminent). All other long-term theses unchanged from July 3. Key structural developments this week: (1) NVDA Stop Day 1 triggered July 2, Stop Day 2 binary on July 6 US close — long-term Blackwell Ultra thesis entirely unchanged, short-term position management does not affect the 12-month view; (2) SK Hynix Stop Day 1 isolated July 3 KST (₩2,552,000 +10.88%), ADR listing July 10 remains on track; (3) Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story absorbed without HBM4 thesis damage — structurally positive for MU's DoD mandate amplification; (4) US-Iran Islamabad MOU holding (Strait of Hormuz open, Brent ~$70, VIX 15.78) confirms the 'Goldilocks + geopolitical détente' macro regime that underpins the Q3 2026 BUY framework. Warsh FOMC hawkish hold through 2026–2027 remains the primary rate-regime headwind for long-duration growth names — framework unchanged.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.timeframe: 6–12 months (through FY27 earnings cycle; nearest catalyst August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings)
ideas.idea: NVDA is the dominant structural AI infrastructure position. Conviction maintained at HIGH through the Stop Day 2 binary (determined July 6 US close) — the short-term tactical stop protocol does not alter the 12-month Blackwell Ultra / sovereign AI capex thesis. Half-size from July 1 ($200.09) held. Full-size add conditional on July 7 open (NVDA above $200 + SPX >7,460 + VIX <17). CRITICAL H200 CHINA UPDATE: Policy authorized January 16, 2026 (BIS rule, 25% tariff, case-by-case licensing) but China has NOT yet permitted imports and zero H200 revenue has been generated. The 'China reopening catalyst' is a FUTURE event (first import licenses not yet issued), not a current revenue item. When licenses are issued, this unlocks $7–10B in annualized China revenue currently not modeled in Street estimates. August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings ($91B guide) is the fundamental re-rating event.
ideas.why: Blackwell Ultra (GB300 NVL72 = 1.5x GB200 performance) is shipping. Sovereign AI capex from EU, Japan, Saudi Arabia, UAE confirmed at $100B+ combined. NVDA's CUDA software moat requires 18–24 months to replicate — AMD and Intel cannot close in FY27. Every major hyperscaler (MSFT Azure, GOOGL Cloud, AWS, META) committed multi-year NVDA GPU purchases in Q1 2026 earnings calls — not cancellable on short-term sentiment. China H200 import licenses (when issued) represent the single largest unmodeled positive catalyst for NVDA in 2026 — $7–10B annualized revenue not in current Street estimates. The stop protocol is a position management tool, not a thesis invalidation signal.
ideas.driver: China H200 import license issuance (first licenses expected Q3 2026; unlocks $7–10B annualized China revenue); Blackwell B300 GPU ramp H2 2026 expanding compute density 3x vs H100; sovereign AI capex ($100B+ combined); inference demand scaling faster than training as AI moves from development to deployment; Q2 FY27 earnings August 26 ($91B guide); Rubin architecture roadmap 2027 extending moat
ideas.risk: Stop Day 2 triggers July 6 (mandatory exit July 7 — short-term forced selling, not fundamental change); China H200 import licenses delayed past 2026 (removes primary re-rating catalyst); AMD MI400 achieves competitive CUDA-equivalent software ecosystem within 12 months; hyperscaler AI capex cuts H1 2027 if AI monetization disappoints; Warsh rate hold through 2028 compresses 35x forward multiple

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.timeframe: 3–6 months (through Q4 FY26 earnings September 2026; structural 12–18 months through HBM4 supercycle)
ideas.idea: MU is the most compelling near-term AI semi structural buy. Conviction maintained at HIGH. The Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM narrative is a MICRON STRUCTURAL POSITIVE: mobile DRAM share shifting to CXMT (Pentagon 1260H blacklisted) amplifies the US government AI procurement mandate for Micron's Idaho HBM4. DoD cannot use CXMT by law — every HBM4 wafer from Micron's Idaho CHIPS Act fab is DoD-compliant by jurisdiction. $50B Q4 FY26 guide (+40% above prior consensus) confirmed; HBM4 sold out through 2026. No stop protocol, no gate conditions, no ADR mechanics — cleanest structural long in the portfolio. July 6 open creates the first post-holiday tactical entry at $1,150–$1,200.
ideas.why: The CXMT/YMTC blacklist amplification thesis is underappreciated by the Street: DoD AI procurement mandates specifically require US-manufactured memory, and CXMT's blacklist status makes Chinese DRAM non-compliant for the entire US government AI pipeline. Samsung $226B AI data center commitment validates Micron's $50B Q4 guide at national-government scale. The HBM market structural oligopoly (Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron) enforces pricing discipline — no fourth entrant can reach HBM4 EUV production at commercial scale in the next 24 months. Idaho CHIPS Act cost advantage vs Korean competitors is a permanent structural feature, not a one-cycle event.
ideas.driver: HBM4 ramp through H2 2026 ($50B Q4 FY26 guide); CHIPS Act Idaho fab cost advantage and DoD compliance advantage over CXMT; DoD AI procurement mandate for US-manufactured HBM (amplified by Apple/CXMT/YMTC Pentagon blacklist); September Q4 FY26 earnings confirming HBM demand cycle duration; oligopolistic HBM pricing discipline (3-player market, no 4th entrant possible in 24 months)
ideas.risk: HBM demand cycle peaks H1 2027 earlier than expected as AI model efficiency gains reduce memory per compute unit; Samsung aggressive HBM4 pricing to defend NVIDIA share; Q4 FY26 guide miss at September earnings (largest single downside risk); China export controls expand; Micron yield issues at sub-10nm EUV node

ideas.name: SK Hynix
ideas.timeframe: 3–9 months (through ADR seasoning, Q3 2026 earnings August, HBM4 demand cycle through H1 2027)
ideas.idea: SK Hynix conviction maintained at MEDIUM. Stop Day 1 isolated July 3 KST (₩2,552,000 +10.88%). ADR listing July 10 (SKHY, Nasdaq, $29.4B) on track with 4 KRX sessions remaining. Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM catalyst absorbed without HBM4 thesis damage — structural thesis intact. Long-term: SKHY Nasdaq listing creates MSCI World inclusion process (typically 2–3 quarters post-listing for a $29.4B stock) generating systematic demand that cannot exist before July 10. Two gates still required for full-size add (KOSPI >8,500 AND SK Hynix >₩2,700,000 simultaneously). ADR underwriter ceiling at ₩2,723,000 (only ₩23,000 above Gate 2) suggests offering price is being managed near or above Gate 2 level.
ideas.why: SK Hynix's ~70% HBM4 revenue from AI data centers is entirely unaffected by Apple's CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM negotiations. The structural thesis — world's largest HBM3e/HBM4 supplier, NVDA Blackwell B300 partner, $29.4B Nasdaq ADR listing July 10 — is unchanged. The ADR underwriter ceiling convergence with Gate 2 (₩2,723,000 vs ₩2,700,000) is the most important near-term signal: underwriters managing the ceiling near Gate 2 implies the offering price is being set in this range, which validates the gate level as a natural equilibrium. Post-listing MSCI World inclusion is a structural secondary catalyst that has no parallel in any other name in this portfolio.
ideas.driver: July 10 Nasdaq ADR listing (SKHY, $29.4B) and post-listing MSCI World inclusion process; HBM4 ramp as primary NVIDIA Blackwell B300 supplier; Q3 2026 earnings (August) confirming HBM4 ASP premium over HBM3e; KOSPI ADR-listing-driven institutional reallocation; Gate clearance (KOSPI >8,500 AND SK Hynix >₩2,700,000 simultaneously) enabling full-size add
ideas.risk: Apple/CXMT/YMTC negotiations confirmed as done deal — market re-prices mobile DRAM more severely; new Stop Day 1 triggered (any KST close below ₩2,540,000); KOSPI macro deterioration prevents Gate 1 (>8,500) from clearing; NVDA supply diversification toward Samsung if HBM4 yield improves unexpectedly; ADR listing price below ₩2,700,000 ceiling signals underwriter retreat

ideas.name: Meta Platforms
ideas.idea: META carries the highest long-term conviction of any big-tech name on a risk-adjusted basis. Conviction maintained at HIGH. The most direct AI-to-revenue conversion path in the portfolio: every AI ad targeting improvement reaches 3.3B daily active users in real-time without enterprise sales cycles, semiconductor sourcing complexity, or geopolitical trade risk. Zero exposure to Korea shock, H200 China policy, HBM4 supply chain, or BTC gates. FCF $60B+ annual makes META the most rate-resistant large-cap AI name in the Warsh hawkish hold environment. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) is the first full AI-feature quarter at scale — setup for beat and raise.
ideas.why: 3.3B daily active users is an unassailable data and distribution moat. Llama 4 open-source flywheel builds developer ecosystem lock-in with no chip dependency. Zuckerberg AI personal assistant has genuine distribution at scale — improvements reach 3.3B users immediately. The monetization feedback loop has zero lag. META is uniquely insulated from every geopolitical and semiconductor risk identified in this framework. Every macro event in Q3 2026 (Korea shock, China H200 policy, BTC gates, NVDA stop) is zero-impact on META's revenue model — this makes META the risk-adjusted anchor of the big-tech allocation.
ideas.driver: AI ad efficiency compounding at 3.3B user scale (CPM expansion); Llama 4 open-source flywheel building developer ecosystem lock-in; AR/AI glasses integration (Ray-Ban Meta) approaching hardware/software platform status; Q2 2026 earnings (late July) first AI-at-scale quarter; FCF $60B+ annual providing rate-resilient floor in Warsh hawkish hold environment
ideas.risk: Apple iOS ATT 3.0 restricts cross-app tracking further; EU AI Act discriminatory compliance costs exceed $3B; ad recession H2 2026 if US employment deteriorates; AI Reality Labs losses exceed $20B/year offsetting core FCF; Zuckerberg AI assistant privacy litigation in EU or US

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.idea: Microsoft is the most diversified AI monetization play with the strongest rate resilience in the big-tech complex. Conviction maintained at MEDIUM. Azure AI cloud (OpenAI partnership exclusive enterprise deployment), Copilot productivity suite (400M+ 365 commercial seats at $30/month premium), GitHub Copilot (developer workflow capture). No Korea semiconductor exposure. No SPCX bond distribution mechanics. Q3 BUY regime upgrade confirms the enterprise AI adoption tailwind — Copilot seat expansion is the primary revenue driver in 2026. FOMC Warsh hawkish hold through 2027 pressures growth multiples, but MSFT's $100B+ FCF and ~2% dividend yield provide a valuation floor that pure-growth AI names lack.
ideas.why: Enterprise AI adoption in 2026 is about Copilot seat conversion, not new product launches. 400M+ commercial 365 seats converting at 10–20% to Copilot Premium at $30/month = 2.5x revenue per seat vs. base tier. Azure AI workloads are sticky: switching cost is 12–24 months of enterprise IT re-integration. Goldilocks NFP + US BUY regime = enterprise IT budget cycle continues expanding through FY27. OpenAI exclusivity for enterprise Azure fine-tuning creates a 3–5 year switching friction moat. MSFT's $100B+ FCF floor means even a multiple compression from 32x to 25x forward leaves intrinsic value intact.
ideas.driver: Copilot monetization at scale (400M+ 365 commercial seats, 10–20% Copilot Premium penetration at $30/month); Azure AI revenue compounding at 35%+ YoY through FY27; GitHub Copilot Enterprise expansion; sovereign AI infrastructure licensing (EU, Middle East); $100B+ FCF floor providing rate-resilient valuation support in Warsh hawkish hold environment
ideas.risk: OpenAI explores independent cloud or direct enterprise relationships (partnership deteriorates); Google Gemini or Anthropic captures enterprise AI at lower price point; FOMC rate hold through 2028 compresses MSFT multiple from 32x to 25x forward; EU AI Act compliance burden exceeds $5B; enterprise IT spending cuts if US macro deteriorates past Goldilocks

ideas.name: Bitcoin
ideas.timeframe: 12–24 months (post-halving cycle through mid-2027; tactical re-entry Gate 2 tracking tonight)
ideas.idea: Bitcoin's April 2024 halving creates the supply shock that historically precedes a 12–18 month bull cycle peak. Post-halving cycle long-term target: $90,000–$120,000 by mid-2027. GATE 1 CONFIRMED: July 3 UTC midnight close $62,579.40 cleared $62,000 for the first time in 14 sessions. Gate 2 TRACKING LIVE: current session low $62,331 ($331 above $62,000) with ~13 hours remaining. Gate 3 (IBIT): 5-day inflow streak; earliest official confirmation July 6 AM. Long-term conviction upgraded from MEDIUM (watch) to MEDIUM (buy-imminent) — tactical re-entry sequence is the most advanced it has been since the April 2024 halving itself. If Gate 2 confirms tonight and Gate 3 at July 6 open: long-term position re-established.
ideas.why: Halving math is structural: miner daily sell pressure permanently reduced ~450 BTC/day. IBIT institutionalized ETF demand (absent in prior halvings) has absorbed $4.5B in June outflows and is re-accumulating. US crypto regulatory clarity (2026 SEC under new leadership) legitimizes the asset class for institutional allocation. Goldilocks NFP (119K) + US BUY regime is the most constructive macro backdrop for BTC since April 2024. Holiday-thin tape Gate 2 hold ($62,331 low vs $62,000 threshold) is a stronger signal than a gate hold in a liquid full-participation session — lower liquidity means the holding price reflects genuine demand, not momentum noise. US-Iran Islamabad MOU (June 17) and Brent ~$70 reduce the geopolitical risk premium that weighed on BTC through May–June.
ideas.driver: Post-halving supply shock pricing through Q3–Q4 2026 (miner sell pressure -50% permanent); Gate 1 CONFIRMED (July 3 UTC midnight $62,579.40); Gate 2 tracking tonight; IBIT inflow resumption (Gate 3) at July 6 open; US crypto regulatory clarity; US Strategic Reserve sovereign adoption; El Salvador, Bhutan, UAE expanding institutional base; Goldilocks macro regime sustained
ideas.risk: Gate 2 fails tonight ($62,331 retreats below $62,000 on remaining UTC session); IBIT net outflows confirmed at July 6 open (Gate 3 fails); holiday-thin tape amplifies negative headline into cascade; US Congress adverse crypto legislation; BTC post-halving cycle peak lower than prior cycles (diminishing returns thesis)

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.timeframe: 3–12 months (through September 2 first earnings; December 9 lock-up expiry as structural anchor)

Step-aside tactical posture UNCHANGED at HIGH conviction (bond distribution Day 9 = July 6; re-entry gate est. $185). Long-term structural thesis: September 2 first post-IPO earnings (Starlink ARR, Starship revenue, Cursor AI $500M+ threshold, Starshield classified contracts) is the fundamental anchoring event. IG floor buffer improved to ~$12 (from $6.46 July 2 AH) — Korea-contagion tail risk substantially reduced. Nasdaq 100 inclusion Day 10 (July 7, ~$4.3B passive) permanently embeds SPCX in QQQ/QQQM systematic flows. The $148–$165 accumulation window may be the structural 2026 entry zone — every distribution session above $150 IG floor preserves re-entry optionality. December 9 lock-up expiry (float +4% → 9–14%) creates a supply ceiling at $185–$200 that makes the $185 re-entry gate the minimum acceptable entry.
ideas.why: Space infrastructure is at the same inflection that cloud computing crossed in 2012–2014: cost curves have collapsed (Falcon 9 250+ reflights, Starship development cost-per-orbit declining 90%+ vs prior generation) but revenue generation is in commercial innings 1–2. Starlink is profitable. SpaceX DoD backlog is $10B+. Cursor AI coding assistant crosses the $500M ARR threshold for first-earnings disclosure. The December 9 lock-up expiry creates a structural supply ceiling at $185–$200 before and after September 2 earnings — the $185 re-entry gate specifically clears you of the pre-lock-up supply risk. Korea shock has ZERO direct impact on SpaceX fundamentals (Starlink, Starship, Cursor AI are domestic US revenue stories).
ideas.driver: Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 (~$4.3B QQQ/QQQM systematic demand permanently embedded); bond distribution clearance est. July 9–11 (re-entry gate $185 activation post-clearance); September 2 first post-IPO earnings (Starlink ARR, Starship revenue, Cursor AI $500M+, Starshield); SpaceX equity IPO optionality (2026–2027) creating retail demand for the only liquid public SpaceX vehicle; $150 IG floor institutional bid providing structural floor
